task: Analyze synthetic SXS-like binary black hole waveform accuracy datasets and produce a publication-style report.
named_methodological_commitments: Quantify waveform-resolution error distribution from fig6_data.csv
Quantify mode-by-mode error structure across spherical harmonic modes l=2..8 from fig7_data.csv
Quantify extrapolation-order comparison behavior for N=2 vs 3 and N=2 vs 4 from fig8_data.csv
Produce validation/comparison plots and data overview
Use related work to contextualize expected accuracy trends and interpretation
primary_target_quantities: Median, spread, and tail behavior of waveform differences
Per-mode median and dispersion versus l
Comparative distributions and pairwise relation for extrapolation-order differences
required_outputs: Traceable report with validation and limitations
notes: The workspace contains only synthetic summary datasets rather than full waveforms, so the analysis will characterize catalog-level error distributions and compare them to trends described in related work rather than reconstructing numerical relativity waveforms themselves.
